Fantech Crypto VX7 Gaming Mouse Pink Edition (Adjustable 7200 DPI Sensor / 6 Programmable Macro Buttons / 10 Million Clicks Lifetime Switches / Instant Optical Gaming Sensor / Dynamic RGB Lighting / Ergonomic Ambidextrous Shape)

Upgrade your battle station aesthetics and gaming precision with the Fantech Crypto VX7 Gaming Mouse in vibrant Pink Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered for esports performance and everyday gaming comfort, the VX7 features an instant optical gaming sensor adjustable up to 8000 DPI, 6 fully programmable buttons, long-lasting 10 million click switches, dynamic ambient lighting, and dedicated software customization support.
